notes: ~16.7k Olympia parcels. Source: Thurston County GeoData parcel layer, clipped to the City of Olympia municipal boundary (see run_olympia.py). Baked to PMTiles + H3 hexes (2026-07-01) so the zoomed-out view has a low-zoom aggregate — as a raw GeoParquet layer the small residential parcels dropped out below ~z13 and the city looked empty. Neighborhood region show/hide toggles (Land Value 3D tab + Parking tab). Olympia is a GeoParquet city (no bake) — the widgets compute region counts from the loaded features, so tagging the parquet (augment_olympia_regions.py) + this config is all that's needed.
